title: Jake Barber: 'Who is we?' and black money

tellings.quote: That was the most fascinating part of my Jake interview is he was like, "Who is we?" And I was like, "I don't know. I assume like the US or like whatever, you know, aerospace corporations you might be working for." And and and then he was like, "No, we don't have shit."

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, recalls that when he interviewed a man named Jake Barber, Barber asked him, "Who is we?" Michels guessed he meant the US or the aerospace companies Barber might work for, and Michels says Barber answered, "No, we don't have shit." If true, it would suggest the advanced craft Barber speaks of are not in American or corporate hands.
